text:
Nora (CS Ops): quick heads-up — KestrelPay flagged as ‘at-risk’ in AHS today. renewal in 42 days :warning:
Priya (CSM): saw the signal. usage down 46% last 30d, onboarding checklist shows 3 incomplete items. most recent touch was 18 days ago.
Maya (Account Lead): they cited billing confusion + model quality regression in last customer survey. I put notes in their config doc.
Jamal (Solutions Eng): pinging about the quality regression — I can run a short eval on their top-10 prompts and share diffs by EOD.
Diego (RevOps): pricing/overage was the trigger last Q too. can we offer a temporary usage buffer or credit? need approval from finance for a one-off.
Ava (Enablement): I can run a focused enablement for their data-engineers — 30m session: best-prompts, cache tuning, and quantization tradeoffs. when works?
Priya (CSM): goal = avoid downgrade. proposed 2-week rescue plan: 1) technical health check, 2) enablement session, 3) targeted billing concession, 4) weekly check-ins.
Nora (CS Ops): love that. capture in playbook template under "churn-deflector" and tag #high-touch.
Jamal (Solutions Eng): bottom-line quick tasks: reproduce quality issue, isolate model variant, test fallback to smaller quantized model. commands I will run:
```
./eval_top_prompts --account kestrelpay --limit 10 --output /tmp/kestrel_eval.json
python compare_outputs.py /tmp/kestrel_eval.json baseline.json --metrics rouge,exact_match
```
Priya (CSM): Priya -> Maya -> Diego: can you triage internal approval for a 2-week usage buffer? I’ll prep the customer message.
Maya (Account Lead): on it. looping finance now. cc @Diego.
Diego (RevOps): approved provisional buffer up to 20% for 2 weeks pending results. logging in SF and billing flag set.
Ava (Enablement): scheduled enablement for Thurs 10am PT. sending calendar invites and a short prep doc.
reminder-bot: reminder set — "KestrelPay rescue check-in" in 7 days for progress update.
Priya (CSM): prep customer note draft: short, transparent, two offers (enablement + buffer) and request for prompt samples. will drop in thread.
Nora (CS Ops): small feedback capture addition — ask them to rate the session and drop 3 examples of failed outputs. we’ll use that in regressions.
Priya (CSM): posted draft to thread. feedback welcome.
Jamal (Solutions Eng): if early eval shows model delta > 12% on quality metrics, we do immediate canary to alternate model and monitor.
Maya (Account Lead): great. I’ll own renewal conversation once we show stabilization.
Priya (CSM): next steps checklist (short):
- Jamal: eval + fallback test (EOD)
- Ava: enablement session (Thu 10am PT)
- Diego: buffer applied (done)
- Nora: add playbook entry + tag (today)
- Priya: send customer comms (30m)
Nora (CS Ops): thanks team :white_check_mark: keeping this thread as the single source. update status in thread only.
Priya (CSM): sending customer note now. will follow up after session and Friday check-in. :mag:
